items.title: How to Play the Flood of AI Bonds
items.summary: Recent earnings reports by the so-called hyperscalers have driven expectations even higher for their collective AI spending plans.  Goldman Sachs credit strategists estimate that approximately $400 billion in highly rated investment-grade bonds could be issued directly by hyperscalers globally in 2027.  A group of investment-grade hyperscalers tracked by Barclays credit strategists includes  Alphabet Amazon.com Meta Platforms Microsoft Oracle  and  SpaceX.  The spread offered by these companies’ bonds over benchmark Treasurys has widened by almost a quarter percentage point over the past month through July 30, according to tracking by Barclays.
